svg.aria-label: Transactional outbox: the service writes the business row and an outbox row in the same database transaction; a relay reads the outbox and publishes to the message broker, so the event is published if and only if the data was saved.
svg.title: Transactional outbox: the service writes the business row and an outbox row in the same database transaction; a relay reads the outbox and publishes to the message broker, so the event is published if and only if the data was saved.
svg.text: ✗ write DB, then publish: crash in between = lost or phantom event
